entries.0d80a08874064a38: A business made up of the company, SAS SB Traduction, Torindo Co., Ltd. and PMC Co., Ltd., which provides design support for products and equipment using 3D-CAD, consulting based on technical information, and the production of various manuals and digital content.
entries.781f9d8fc6e04e9f: A company that supports automakers and others from product development through manufacturing, sales and service, through three businesses: design support and manual production, FA robots, and core system development.
entries.84415674eac99719: This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary Bainas Co., Ltd., which manufactures robots and FA systems, develops control software, manufactures and sells FA-related educational systems, and provides educational support services. Centering on the development of FA robot systems for a variety of manufacturing processes, it proposes labor-saving in manufacturing and manufactures and sells the robot training device “Robo-Trainer.” Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥942 million.
entries.8609bd66c2f3d48a: This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary Bainas Co., Ltd., which manufactures robots and FA systems, develops control software, manufactures and sells FA-related educational systems, and provides educational support services.
entries.ad6257bfc397f3c5: This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary MCOR Co., Ltd., which undertakes planning, design, construction and operation of IT infrastructure, systems integration, hardware maintenance, and development of embedded software and related work. It centers on the development of systems such as CAD, CAE and BoM, and also focuses on contracted control design for MBD, control software development, and introduction support, customization and data integration for major PLM systems. Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥4,399 million.
entries.d703b14343bb3ad8: Manufacturing industries, including automobiles and industrial equipment
entries.f9ef8c362fc2b9b0: This business consists of the company, SAS SB Traduction, Torindo Co., Ltd. and PMC Co., Ltd., and provides design support for products and equipment using 3D-CAD, consulting based on technical information, and production of various manuals and digital content. The company undertakes 3D-CAD design work and dispatches engineers; SAS SB Traduction in France handles multilingual translation and software localization; Torindo Co., Ltd. handles production of multilingual manuals for IT-related equipment and business equipment and various translations; and PMC Co., Ltd. produces instruction manuals, various manuals, catalogs and others. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥3,485 million.
